usedFor: Every Calendly booking becomes one row in your Google Sheets schedule.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Calendly pushes each booking as made, so you get one row per meeting without polling duplicates.

watchOut: “Invitee Canceled” can feed “Delete Rows”, which has no undo, so check it removes the right booking.
